newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW says expects higher 1997 sales, profit.
newsitem.headline: VW says expects higher 1997 sales, profit.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen AG said on Monday it expected to report higher sales and profit in 1997, provided demand for vehicles around the world remains relatively stable.
"Provided that economic conditions and also the demand for automobiles remain steady, we expect better results in 1997 at both the parent and group levels," VW said in a statement.

The carmaker on Monday also said its first quarter group sales rose to 26.86 billion marks ($15.6 billion) from 24.47 billion in the year-ago quarter and group net profit increased to 172 million marks from 116 million in the 1996 quarter.
